dedupe_keys.name: boites a livres dans les gares franciliennes

description: Boîtes à livres dans les gares franciliennes is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Île-de-France. Des boîtes installées dans les gares ou à leurs abords, où chacun peut prendre et déposer des ouvrages: ce sont les Boîtes à livres, que la Région déploie dans une centaine de gares franciliennes. Le but: donner à tous et partout une irrésistible envie de lire, aux voyageurs du quotidien comme aux simples passants. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Vie culturelle. Its keywords are Lecture, Livre, Médiathèque, Transports en commun, Gare. The portal shows 100 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-11-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
